title: Jordynne Grace vs. Masha Slamovich
summary: Masha Slamovich’s unbeaten rise meets Jordynne Grace’s championship strength. Their first major collision ends in disappointment for Masha, but a later return to the same stage produces her breakthrough.

chapters.title: Grace stops the unbeaten challenger
chapters.result: Jordynne defeats Masha to retain the Knockouts title.
chapters.context: Masha’s dominant run cannot carry her past the champion. The result establishes the obstacle she must eventually overcome.

chapters.title: Masha finally defeats Grace
chapters.result: Slamovich wins the Knockouts world championship.
chapters.context: Two years after her first Bound for Glory challenge, Masha reverses the result against Grace. This is a later chapter of the rivalry, rather than a claim of uninterrupted weekly conflict.
